resources.name: Receiving and long-stock racks
resources.specification: Cantilever stock racks, wheelset cradles, protected stores, quarantine, heat/serial tagging and contained handling. Rate rack, aisle and floor to vendor packages and actual loads.

resources.name: Guarded section and liner saw
resources.specification: 350 × 320 mm reference throat, positive clamp, input/output roller support and 12 m finished chord access with incoming trim allowance. Prove largest section and full-length cut. Include mains, coolant, chip containment and blade-change access.

resources.name: Bench preparation and liner drilling
resources.specification: Guarded drill with replaceable liner bushings and countersink stop, deburr bench and finish/squareness gauges, with local dust extraction. Demonstrate six positions per liner, edge distance, flushness and mate fit.

resources.name: Nested plate blank supply
resources.specification: Cut and mark 8 mm gussets and 12 mm pads, allow finish stock, capture mill heat, flatness and edge condition. Reserve equivalent capacity at supplier; handoff queue and transport outside cell hours.

resources.name: Indexed 17 m body build bed
resources.specification: 18 × 3.2 m concept envelope, modular surveyed bed, replaceable locator towers, clamps, door and splice bridge inserts, equipment escape and lift access. Include crew/vacancy for each scheduled bed and prove geometry with load and hot-to-cold checks.

resources.name: Removable bogie frame weld bed
resources.specification: 3.2 × 2.5 m concept envelope, pin axle planes from railhead and use removable seat locators, open gauging windows and rated handling after clamp release. Demonstrate repeatability after thermal cycles.

resources.name: Mobile pulsed MIG/MAG and source capture
resources.specification: 400 A class pulsed unit with compatible gun, gas distribution and extraction at each active station. Return rated current at expected ambient and arc duty, actual input demand, airflow and simultaneous draw. Time assumes single occupied set per cell task; validate peak overlap of both body beds and bogie bed.

resources.name: Shared runway handling and rigging
resources.specification: Rate for heaviest actual lifted assembly, certified spreaders, slings, support reactions, headroom and travel. Dedicated bulk moves booked to one resource across receiving and bays.

resources.name: Shared portable tracker and dimensional QA
resources.specification: One tracker with survey targets, probe and calibrated local gauges. Verify plant temperature, setup uncertainty and repeated datum survey before moving between cells.

resources.name: Weld inspection and NDT
resources.specification: Series QA visual inspection during work and periodic contract NDT with approved method for each location and procedure. Joint times are booking proxies. Access, extent and qualification controlled by approved plan.

resources.name: Contract bogie seat and datum machining
resources.specification: Single datum registration across both axle planes, finish seats and mating holes under approved drawing. Confirm spindle reach, fixture and probing repeatability. Book freight and supplier queue separately.

resources.name: Contract blast and coating
resources.specification: Process 17 m body and bogie frames; verify fixture access, blast/film/cure checks, masking and drains. Separate transport and painted-part storage.

resources.name: Bogie integration with clean stands
resources.specification: Positive anti-roll support and keyed axle cradle, calibrated torque tooling and verified lift fixtures. Fit approved drive, spring, stops and brake assemblies with tool windows and full-load clearances.

resources.name: Wheelset and supplier bearing assembly
resources.specification: Procure certified wheelsets and mounted bearings under supplier procedures. Review journal fit, manufacturer endplay and retained force-displacement trace where applicable; supplier assembly resource only.

resources.name: Restrained bogie functional stand
resources.specification: Protected stand, logged drive/brake and leak function to approved plan, electrical and fluid isolation and measured alignment. Repeated thermal and braking proof requires independently agreed instrumentation and loads.

resources.name: Portal and liner fixture with door support trolley
resources.specification: Replaceable liner drill template, flush screw and retention gauges, 1,300 mm clear-aperture gauge and finite-travel surrogate plus door handling trolley. Fixture use is an occupation subtotal inside the body fit operation.

resources.name: Body mechanical and cabin fit
resources.specification: Movable platforms, hand tools, depth/torque tools and nominated support for roof lift. Complete roof, door, interior and external weather sealing check; supplier BOM pending for several fitout groups.

resources.name: Electrical cabinet and harness build benches
resources.specification: ESD and isolated power, enclosure drilling/marking, crimp and pull verification, keyed boards and adapters, cable/hose service loops, strain relief and calibrated bond checks. Bench occupation per vehicle kit pending conductor, cabinet and connector schedule. Purchase safety electronics and prequalified HV modules.

resources.name: Shared cabinet and harness tester
resources.specification: Expandable continuity/IR tester, keyed drawings and adapter plates, controlled test voltages and isolation for sensitive components, interlocked test cover, reference checks and serial logs. Count per car kit pending actual harness list.

resources.name: Onboard collector set install tools
resources.specification: Portable locator and insulated isolation kit. Return spring/contact limits, polarity, terminal access and stroke checks for car-role allocation under an approved test.

resources.name: Body lift and marriage road
resources.specification: Synchronized rated lift set and mechanical supports with verified concentrated floor loads, guarded pallet/cradle and approved lifting points. Use separate maintenance equipment for repair road. Record load balance, lift movement, shim stack, retention and service coupling.

resources.name: Static integration and factory acceptance test road
resources.specification: Calibrated equipped-car wheel-load system and isolation, bonding, controlled LV/drive and brake witness equipment. Data recorder links each serial and test revision. Separate full-train static booking and independent route qualification.

resources.name: Set-level integration and controls test road
resources.specification: Book a staging or test track long enough for six 17 m cars, actual coupler gaps, access and clearances. Protect and isolate test area. Interface the inter-car wiring, controls, braking, fault handling and emergency release in a witnessed static test.

load.note: Six set-level bookings derived from two ATP channels per set. The ATP count is a set proxy, not a duplication of the car checks.

resources.name: Off-line exchange and repair road
resources.specification: Dedicated approved jack/support and rail pallet, wheel gauges, isolation and repair benches. One hour/car is a reserved occupation allowance, pending reject rates and equipped exchange trials. Reserve repair crew separately. Use a distinct depot budget for the road and contracted overhaul.

resources.name: Wet-cast box mould and prestress position
resources.specification: 10 m closed box with separable core, removable bulkheads, 180 mm webs, 200 mm slabs and cast ends. Prove core extraction and restrain core flotation. Qualify the complete reaction system for the two aligned six-strand banks, eccentricity and unbalanced release.
resources.note: Base case assumes 24 elapsed hours per box and one independently occupied box per position. The guide sizes the 48-hour and two-position alternative.

resources.name: Beam reinforcement cage build and check jig
resources.specification: Provide coordinated cut-and-bend feed and cage stock staging. Gauge U-bar laps, cover, strand setbacks, inserts and dense end reinforcement. Validate the assumed staffed cycle with a timed cage.

resources.name: Calibrated stressing and controlled detensioning plant
resources.specification: Include jack, pump, gauges, release equipment and functioning calibrated checks, elongations, anchor heads, working tails and exclusion zones. Return the approved load and sequence for each independent line.

resources.name: Shared batching and concrete delivery to placement crews
resources.specification: Trial 20 m³/h gross placement feed. Verify actual net yield, mix families, humidity/temperature controls, batch traceability, test frequency, transport and staggered placements.
resources.note: Both lines draw on this service. Planned panel peaks require a separate concurrent placement check.

unknown_demand: station bay panels after plant and access openings

resources.name: Beam placement, vibration and finishing crews
resources.specification: Trial two occupied crew hours per box including placement, vibration and finish. Sequence releases, supply of fresh concrete and pour continuity across multiple moulds. Staff early and late windows if demanded by the staggered 24-hour return.

resources.name: Beam yard lifting and trailer loadout
resources.specification: Approve actual hook load and rigging geometry for removal and dunnage placement plus trailer loadout. Confirm safe crane travel, pick path, actual span and independent cage/core lifting arrangements.

resources.name: Single-tier beam storage and dispatch buffer
resources.specification: Trial allowance 176 single-tier beam slots based on monthly release profile, with designed dunnage, lateral restraint, survey and serial number access. Add separately circulating routes, quarantine and repair access.
resources.note: Stock buffer uses peak inventory rather than cumulative processing hours.

resources.name: Beam tractor, matched trailer and haul crew
resources.specification: One beam per trip. Return surveyed access, wheel loads, restraints, permits, escorted route and actual pick/set readiness. Synchronise eight loads to each eight-lift day.
resources.note: Four-hour round-trip sensitivity includes yard and front dwell. Full eight-hour transport window is a trial. A usable seven-hour window permits only one complete round trip per set if trips must start and finish in that window.

resources.name: Foundation, column and cap work areas
resources.specification: Record soil, utilities, excavation, base bearing, settlement and flood/seismic limits. Return site-specific stage hours, crew/rig choices, curing, test hold and approved seat elevations.
resources.note: No rated site production quantity. At eight pier positions/day, each day of release-stage occupancy adds eight open positions. Derive rigs, forms and crews from the boreholes, surveyed access and first installed support.

resources.name: Bearing seat survey and installation crews
resources.specification: Verify bearing contact, edge distances, axes, rotation and keeper engagement, drainage, survey and future jack access. Confirm approved anchor, grout and movement interfaces.
resources.note: 0.2 hours per bearing is an active alignment and inspection allowance. Add grout cure stage occupancy to the verified support calendar.

resources.name: Site erection front and at-radius crane service
resources.specification: Include site crane, approved rig and crew, site access and traffic control. Return actual configuration chart, ground pressures, paved and off-road travel, slew and lift clearances, weather limits, temporary restraints and signed seat release.
resources.note: Six active hook hours in each eight-hour possession after 1.5 hours for setup/reposition/closeout and 0.5 hours for interruption. 0.75 hours per lift includes spotting, pick, slew, seat and release.

resources.name: Flat station panel casting table
resources.specification: Trial four table places for one standard bay per productive day. Use adaptable shutters and gauges for connections, edge, crossfall, inserts and tolerance.
resources.note: Repeat of trial 4.98 × 1.98 × 0.28 m panel. Final demand and mix of panel sizes are open.

resources.name: Panel strip, yard and dispatch handling
resources.specification: Return tested insert and handling scheme for each size, verified minimum strength, lifting weight, surveyed protective storage and segregated handling window.

resources.name: Adjustable enclosure and removable backplate assembly stand
resources.specification: Adjustable stops, replaceable drilling template, insulated terminal and label kit, controlled torque tools and ESD provision as applicable. Obtain enclosure dimensions, assembly mass, lifting and safe work envelope before specifying the stand.

resources.name: Wire preparation, labelled kitting and crimp inspection station
resources.specification: Provide cut-to-length and strip tools, interchangeable calibrated dies, label printer, terminal samples and a pull-test instrument. Agree conductor sizes, ferrules, polarity, tooling/die compatibility and supplier acceptance limits. HV busbars, contact rail and power cables belong to their power-system lots.

resources.name: Isolated low-voltage I/O proving bench with removable test harness
resources.disposition: build jig and buy calibrated instruments
resources.specification: Provide isolated supply, point-to-point breakout, simulated contacts/loads, independent recorder and per-revision adapters. Capture wrong addressing and loss of supply or feedback. Return calibration, test duration and evidence for each serial. Live fault-duty and protection discrimination remain separate witnessed trials.

resources.name: Supplier switchgear and rectifier test provision
resources.specification: Return tested assemblies per site, ratings, rigs, inspection capacity, traceable results and independent witnessing allowance. The 30 source groups are installation locations. The manufactured cabinet count is open.

load.note: Illustrative rig booking per cabinet for capacity enquiry only. Return the actual test sequence and occupied time.

product_routes.name: Gross RHS and liner blanks
product_routes.route: Receive, saw, trim, deburr and mark
product_routes.inspection: First-off heat, setup, length, square/angle and traceability

product_routes.name: Plate gussets and seat blanks
product_routes.route: Nest, cut, mark, deburr and dimensional check
product_routes.inspection: Heat, dimensions and released edge/finish allowance

product_routes.name: Braced steel body
product_routes.route: Preset side fields, join under dimensional control, inspect and coat
product_routes.inspection: Body release with joint and datum records after unclamping

product_routes.name: Powered bogie
product_routes.route: Join, inspect, machine, coat and integrate axle, suspension, drive and brake
product_routes.inspection: Seat and axle survey, mounting records and restrained functional check
product_routes.disposition: local integration and supplier safety assemblies

product_routes.name: Wheelsets and bearing seats
product_routes.route: Buy traceable wheelsets and approved mounted bearings
product_routes.inspection: Seat position is distinct from the supplier bearing component count

product_routes.name: Door opening assemblies
product_routes.route: Fit liners, slide/stop/retention hardware and complete door; set and verify
product_routes.inspection: Eight loaded/worn apertures and full leaves sweep per car; proof of return/anti-drop
product_routes.disposition: buy complete door and fabricate liners

product_routes.name: Door liner hardware
product_routes.route: Prepare and fit approved flush fasteners
product_routes.inspection: Six paired positions per liner, stock fastener strength and access subject to joint design

product_routes.name: Roof HVAC modules
product_routes.route: Receive, stage, lift, fasten, connect and test
product_routes.inspection: Fitted mass and mount, removal sweep, cool/condensate, bond and leak tests

product_routes.name: Onboard electrical cabinet and harness kits
product_routes.route: Prepare cabinet/boards by car role, cut/build harness, bench-test and install
product_routes.inspection: Kit proxy per car, individual cabinet and harness count open. Validate crimp, continuity, isolation and installed flex
product_routes.disposition: local build and supplier safety modules

product_routes.name: Onboard collector sets
product_routes.route: Fit suspended collector sets by role, connect and align
product_routes.inspection: Check actual travel, contact forces and protective clearances

product_routes.name: Drive, brake and spring interfaces
product_routes.route: Clean assembly and torque, protect fluid/electrical runs and verify restraint
product_routes.inspection: Preserve individual quantities by family; independent brake and parking friction scope open

product_routes.name: Equipped cars
product_routes.route: Marriage, weigh, static test and stage six sets
product_routes.inspection: Serialised retention, flexible services, electrical and release/test records

product_routes.name: Track beam
product_routes.route: Cut/bend and cage, set core and ends, pretension, inspect, cast, protect/cure, verify strength, detension and strip, inspect, store, release to trailer.
product_routes.inspection: Hold for pre-pour cage and insert survey, batch and cure records, calibrated strand force/elongation, approved concrete strength at transfer and lifting, and measured camber and mass.

product_routes.name: Beam delivery and erection
product_routes.route: Dispatch by seat readiness, haul, clear possession, rig, place, provisionally restrain, release, survey.
product_routes.inspection: Actual crane chart and safe radius, verified rig, ground/temporary stability, bearing contact and geometry, as-installed rail and traction interface tolerances.

product_routes.name: Pier and foundation positions
product_routes.route: Survey and investigate, stage utilities and access, excavate, build footing and superstructure support, verify cure, survey seats and release contiguous site bays.
product_routes.inspection: Ground, strength, temporary stability, geometry, offset, settlement and independent site acceptance.

product_routes.name: Bearing provision
product_routes.route: Approve seat, bearing, guide, jack and restraint scheme, procure, identify position, survey and fit, grout where specified, confirm release.
product_routes.inspection: Confirm seat plane, anchors, restraint, rated reaction and movement, and future replacement clearances.

product_routes.name: Station deck panel
items: station bay panels after plant and access openings
product_routes.route: Issue station panel family, set shutters and cage, cast and finish, cure, verify lifting strength, remove, stage, dispatch and fit to station datums.
product_routes.inspection: Check panel width and length, finish and fall, joints, edge geometry, openings and accessible boarding gap and step on the surveyed installation.

product_routes.name: Wired and labelled wayside control assemblies
product_routes.disposition: locally integrate bought modules and qualified protection equipment
product_routes.route: Issue revision and terminal list, prepare removable panel, kit and label conductors, fit modules, terminate, inspect, bench-test and preserve serial record.
product_routes.inspection: List quantities by allocated position, then return actual panel/terminal drawings, as-wired continuity, isolation, addressing and controlled configuration for each serial.

product_routes.name: Installed and tested rectifier cabinets
product_routes.route: Match the selected radial circuit, approve the supplier drawings, witness the production tests and pass the evidence to the installing contractor.
product_routes.inspection: Check serials, declared fault duty, interlocks, protection study and inspection record against the issued site and circuit.

fixture_items.name: Primary datum wear pad
fixture_items.route: Machine three replaceable pads for the fixture reference plane. Mark the jig and position, survey installed faces and retain the calibration record.

fixture_items.name: Centreline survey monument
fixture_items.route: Machine and attach target nests outside the joining heat zone. Record the two target locations and the transform to the car frame.

fixture_items.name: Adjustable longitudinal reference stop
fixture_items.route: Fabricate the bolted stop base, machine the replaceable contact face and inspect its position against the car datum.

fixture_items.name: Primary seat locator block
fixture_items.route: Machine replaceable blocks for the four primary positions at local x ±1,050 and y ±1,040 mm. Survey jig faces before and after the trial weld.

fixture_items.name: Secondary seat locator block
fixture_items.route: Machine and identify a left and right locator at local x 0 and y ±850 mm. Inspect the face height and protect the approved reference surfaces during transport.

fixture_items.name: Removable end bulkhead assembly
fixture_items.route: Fabricate the two end assemblies around the coordinated insert and strand pattern. Trial form fit, strand clearance, core extraction and removal sequence on the approved casting arrangement. Prestress anchorage is designed separately.

fixture_items.name: Box core former set
fixture_items.route: Make one removable or collapsible core set per active mould position. Demonstrate extraction, restraint and mold survey before repeating the tool. The sections per set await the chosen core mechanism.

fixture_items.name: Replaceable I/O breakout carrier
fixture_items.route: Issue the approved low-voltage terminal list, produce a labelled removable backplate, fit the keyed test harness and check every route against the independent point list. Connector type and the number of mating adapter variants stay open.
